text:
meera: Heads-up 1: quick scrub of the API Keys screen mock. Looking for final microcopy and any accessibility missed spots. Posting frames in the thread.

sam: quick take: empty state feels a bit passive. header reads 'No keys yet' 1 maybe stronger: 'Protect your app with an API key'. CTA copy: 'Create API key' or 'Add key now'? I prefer action-first.

jeremy: +1 to action-first. Also: in the list, can we show an icon for 'last used' and 'expires in' next to each key? Small dot + relative time. Helps SREs spot stale keys.

kat: accessibility checklist: - Ensure empty-state illustration has aria-hidden=true and a text-only caption off-screen describing the graphic. - All modals need keyboard focus trap; first interactive element must be focused. - For copy buttons, use aria-live="polite" region to announce "API key copied".

meera: thanks. For the rotate flow, thinking of a two-step modal: Step 1: generate new key (preview, copy once), Step 2: finalize rotation which invalidates the old key. People kept being surprised that rotate invalidates immediately. We should surface timing and options.

sam: could we offer a safe 'staged rotation' option: new key is issued and old key stays valid for X minutes. UI: slider or quick preset (1h/24h/never). That reduces deploy friction.

jeremy: love staged rotation. But add a clear badge: 'Overlap window: 60 minutes' with tooltip explaining risk. Also show code snippet example how to swap keys in common SDKs.

meera: microcopy proposal for rotate modal header: 'Rotate API key 1 create a replacement and set an overlap window.' Body bullets: - New key will be created and shown once. Copy it to update your apps. - Keep the old key valid for a chosen overlap window. - Finalize rotation to immediately retire the old key. Buttons: 'Create replacement' and secondary 'Cancel'.

kat: wording nits: avoid passive language like 'will be created' 1 use direct verbs: 'Create replacement key', 'Keep old key valid for', 'Finalize to retire old key'. ARIA: confirm dialogs should set role=alertdialog.

sam: revoke flow: suggestion to require typing the key name (not 'DELETE') for high-privilege keys. Maybe only enforce for keys with 'Full' scope.

jeremy: on the list page, show scope chip e.g., 'Embeddings', 'Read', 'Full' with tooltip describing real permissions. For discoverability, add an 'example calls' link that shows what each scope actually allows.

meera: empty state microcopy draft: header: 'Secure access with an API key' body: 'Create a key to start calling Redwood endpoints. You can restrict scopes and rotate keys anytime.' Primary CTA: 'Create API key' Secondary: 'Key best practices' (links to docs). Illustration alt text (off-screen): 'Illustration: a lock and a token on a dashboard.'

kat: color/contrast: primary CTA must be AA at small text. Current blue fails on 12px. Use darker blue or adjust weight. Also check focus outline for keyboard (2px solid, 3:1 contrast).

sam: small UI question: masked preview shows last 6 chars. For screen reader users, we should not read masked characters; aria-label should read 'API key, ends with ABC123'. That keeps privacy but useful context.

meera: good call. I'll update Figma with the staged rotation modal, new empty state, and chip styles. Action items: meera update mocks by Wed, sam spec overlap windows + presets, jeremy add SDK swap snippets, kat produce final a11y checklist and aria examples.

design-bot: Reminder: follow-up design sync scheduled Wed 11/01 10:30AM 1 calendar invite updated.

meera: thanks team. I'll paste the new frames and a copy diff once they're uploaded.
